service.description: Executes a single pipeline compute step. Records an AgiPipelineStep in PlsExecuting status, triggers the AI agent dispatch, writes the output into AgiPayload, and updates egressPayloadId upon completion.
Creates an unexecuted draft step branching off an existing step. Optionally clones the source payload if modifications were made. egressPayloadId is explicitly left null.
Recursively flags an AgiPipelineStep and all downstream descendant steps as PlsArchived.
